title: Parking in Fire Lane/Fire Hydrants
categories: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
description: Use this service request to report vehicles that are parked in marked fire lanes or vehicles parked on the street within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is the vehicle parked at location now?

branches.No: Validation Alert: No action is needed if the vehicle is no longer at location.

observedQuestions.prompt: What time of day is the problem occurring?
What is the make of the vehicle?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Vehicle currently parked = Yes; weekday mornings; make = Other; color and plate supplied

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a vehicle parked in a fire lane or near a fire hydrant.
actions.why: For a vehicle currently parked in a marked fire lane or on a street within 15 feet of a fire hydrant. The 311 request form asks whether it remains there, when the problem occurs, and the vehicle make, color, and plate.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Parking in Fire Lane/Fire Hydrants" requests is not needed when the vehicle is no longer at the location; the 311 request form says no action is needed for that answer.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Parking in Fire Lane/Fire Hydrants"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Parking in Fire Lane/Fire Hydrants"
